headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update | Sector: Cement SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of 2QFY27 result Tepid volume growth YoY; Margins under pressure due to challenging operating environment: JK Lakshmi Cement reported muted 2Q volume growth of 4.9% YoY to 3.0 mn tonnes impacted by heavy monsoons in key markets (Chhattisgarh and coastal Gujarat) and planned maintenance shutdowns.
Due to muted demand, cement prices were flat for most of the quarter and gained momentum from late September through October across trade and non-trade segments.
This resulted in a marginal 0.6% YoY improvement in blended realizations at Rs 5,420 per ton.
Weaker volume growth coupled with flat realizations led to a muted consolidated revenue growth of 5.6% YoY at Rs 1,617 cr.
valuation: Premium cement share stood at 27% with management targeting 28%–30%.
Green power share reached 48% (target to reach ~49%+ in 2HFY27).
Management has revised its FY30 capacity target from 30 MTPA to 25 MTPA in order to maintain balance sheet discipline and keep net Debt to EBITDA below 3.5x.

Near-term Outlook: Management expects volumes to match industry growth (~7%–8%) in 2HFY27 and anticipates sequential realization gains of ~Rs 10/ton each in October and November and ~Rs 15/ton in December.
